summary: Iteration 2 of Merizo (Smart Limit + Reminders + Scan Bill + boxShadow migration). Backend: 10/10 new tests pass (smart-limit shape & auth; reminders CRUD + complete + 404s; scan-bill validation + real receipt OCR via gpt-4o-mini returning vendor='Tasty Burger Cafe' / amount=472.5 / currency='INR' / category='food' / date='2026-01-15'). Frontend mobile tests pass: SmartLimit widget shows real percent (150% capped, NOT hardcoded 74%), Reminders widget shows '3 active' from real /api/reminders, Reminders screen lists 3 demo + add flow works, Scan screen layout + camera/gallery/back nav work. Zero shadow* deprecation warnings in console after migration to boxShadow.

minor.issue: Demo seed expenses use created_at = now - i days (so Goa+Manali+Buddies expenses paid by Demo all fall within current week). With weekly_budget defaulting to 5000 (no history), demo user shows percent=150 (capped) immediately on first login. Functionally correct but visually the SmartLimit widget always reads MAX for fresh demo accounts. Consider seeding some expenses with created_at older than 7 days so has_history=true and the donut shows a more representative ratio.

issues: Widget renders '150%' label twice (once large center, once around the dial as 'MIN/MAX'); the percent color when capped at 150 should arguably switch to red/negative — currently still uses default tint.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-image-picker@55.0.19 expected ~17.0.11; expo-notifications@55.0.22 expected ~0.32.17; @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 expected 2.2.0; expo-linear-gradient@55.0.13 expected ~15.0.8; react-native-svg@15.15.4 expected 15.12.1. Runtime works on web but `yarn expo install --check` should be run before native builds.

action_items: Optional: bump expo packages with `yarn expo install expo-image-picker expo-notifications expo-linear-gradient @react-native-async-storage/async-storage react-native-svg` to silence doctor warnings.
Optional UX: when /api/smart-limit returns has_history=false, show a 'Set your own weekly budget' affordance instead of defaulting silently to 5000.
Optional UX: red/negative tint when smart-limit percent >= 100.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/scan-bill correctly strips data: prefix, validates min length (100 chars), wraps LlmChat in try/except, falls back to JSON-substring parsing if model wraps response in prose. Returns 422 if amount missing. Good defensive parsing.
server.py /api/smart-limit only counts expenses where exp.paid_by == my_member_id. This is 'spend by you', not 'your share'. Acceptable interpretation but worth confirming with PM.
server.py is now ~1000 lines — split-threshold breached; consider modules: auth, trips, reminders, ai (smart_limit + scan_bill).
frontend/app/reminders.tsx: scheduleReminder() uses Notifications.SchedulableTriggerInputTypes.DATE — correct API for SDK 55 expo-notifications.
frontend/app/scan.tsx: web camera falls back to gallery (good); however on web the picker also requires user gesture — covered by TouchableOpacity onPress so OK.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 iteration-2 tests; previous 17 also still passing)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (smart-limit, reminders widget+screen+add, scan screen+nav, zero shadow* warnings)

seed_data_creation: Test data 'TEST_reminder' created during the create→complete→delete flow is fully cleaned up by the test (DELETE 200 then DELETE 404). One UI-test 'Test reminder' was added via the Add sheet during Playwright run and not cleaned up — it sits in the demo user's reminders list until the next backend restart re-seeds, or can be removed manually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 endpoints (/api/smart-limit, /api/reminders [GET/POST/PATCH-complete/DELETE], /api/scan-bill) covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py. Real receipt OCR uses a PIL-generated synthetic JPEG with text — works deterministically. Run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v` to re-run all tests. Frontend testIDs: smart-limit, widget-reminders, widget-insights, quick-scan, reminders-back, reminders-add, rem-title, rem-amount, rem-when-{0,1,3,7}, rem-submit, rem-complete-{id}, rem-delete-{id}, scan-back, scan-camera-btn, scan-gallery-btn, scan-submit-btn, scan-preview, scan-edit-name, scan-edit-amount, scan-trip-{id}, scan-add-btn.

Real receipt OCR returned correct structured JSON: {vendor: 'Tasty Burger Cafe', amount: 472.5, currency: 'INR', category: 'food', date: '2026-01-15', suggested_name: 'Burger meal'}.
